Read `AGENTS.md` first if you haven't in this session: it lists the tools, the project folder and the person's preferences. Combine the tools however the request needs; `./lky backends` shows which models work on this machine.

Worked examples (read one that is close to the request and adapt it; they are not rules):

- `flows/app-demo.md` (ready): A demo video of an app (web, terminal or desktop): you drive and record the app yourself, then narration and zooms.
- `flows/edit-recording.md` (ready): The person recorded a video (screencast, talk) and wants it edited and ready for YouTube.
- `flows/generated-short.md` (ready): A Short made from a topic: script, narration with TTS, animated scenes, captions. Nothing to record.
- `flows/long-to-shorts.md` (ready): Make vertical Shorts (9:16, word-by-word captions) from the best moments of a long video.
- `flows/script-then-record.md` (ready): You write the script; the person records it with a teleprompter (OBS takes per line); the takes are matched to the script and edited together.
- `flows/voice-over.md` (ready): The person has a video without narration (or with narration to replace) and wants a voice added.
